title: ClearFrame Client
description: A lightweight client-side only modpack that enhances Minecraft vanilla with better performance, visuals, and immersion — fully server compatible.
body:
**Vanilla+ Client Optimization** is a carefully curated **client-side–only modpack** that enhances Minecraft’s vanilla experience by focusing on **performance, visual clarity, and immersion**, without introducing gameplay changes or server dependencies.

The goal of this modpack is simple:  
**make Minecraft feel smoother, cleaner, and more immersive while remaining purely vanilla at its core.**

Thanks to a modern optimization stack built around **Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, and BadOptimizations**, the game achieves higher frame rates, reduced stuttering, and more efficient rendering, even on lower-end systems. Chunk rendering, entity visibility, and memory usage are all improved without sacrificing visual fidelity.

On the immersive side, the modpack introduces **dynamic lighting**, **realistic sound propagation**, and **subtle visual upgrades** that respect the original art style. Connected glass, improved leaves culling, and optional 3D models for specific blocks add depth to the world while keeping everything recognizably vanilla.

For players who want a more cinematic experience, **Iris Shaders** is included with full compatibility for **Complementary Shaders – Unbound**, offering advanced lighting, shadows, reflections, and atmospheric effects — all fully optional and configurable.

All configuration menus are handled through **YetAnotherConfigLib**, making it easy to tweak performance and visuals to suit your hardware and preferences.

Most importantly, **Vanilla+ Client Optimization is 100% client-side**.  
No mods are required on the server, meaning you can use this modpack in **singleplayer, LAN worlds, and any multiplayer server** without compatibility issues.

***

## What This Modpack Is

*   A **vanilla-focused** enhancement pack
    
*   **Performance-first**, without visual clutter
    
*   **Client-side only** and server-safe
    
*   Easy to configure and lightweight
    

## What This Modpack Is NOT

*   ❌ Not a gameplay overhaul
    
*   ❌ Not a content-expansion modpack
    
*   ❌ Not required on servers
